description: Taparia MD Series - Masonry Drill Bits Taparia MD Series masonry drill bits are engineered for precision drilling in Wall, masonry, and brick applications, delivering professional-grade performance for Home and renovation projects. These high-quality Hammer drill bits feature premium tungsten carbide tips that enable long-lasting, consistent drilling through tough masonry materials. Available in comprehensive sizes from 3mm to 13mm with lengths ranging from 30mm to 150mm, these masonry bits incorporate fully hardened drill body construction to prevent bending during intensive use while ensuring extended tool life. The straight shank design provides secure chuck grip and compatibility with standard drill machines, rotary drills, and impact drivers. Each concrete drilling bit features precision-engineered flute geometry for efficient debris removal and reduced drilling resistance. The tungsten carbide cutting edges maintain sharpness through extensive use in concrete, brick, stone, and masonry block applications. These professional masonry drill bits come in protective plastic tube packaging to prevent damage during storage and transport. Perfect for contractors, builders, and DIY enthusiasts seeking reliable masonry drilling solutions, these concrete bits deliver consistent performance across various construction materials. ISO-9001 certified manufacturing ensures superior quality and durability for demanding drilling applications.
